\subsection*{You'll want to know: \kn{ನಿರ್ಜನ}}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\kn{ಅಚ್ಚುಕಟ್ಟಾದ} (accukaṭṭāda)}{ಅಚ್ಚುಕಟ್ಟಾದ (accukaṭṭāda)}]{\kn{ಅಚ್ಚುಕಟ್ಟಾದ} (accukaṭṭāda) — tidy, well-organised}

\textbf{\kn{ಅಚ್ಚುಕಟ್ಟಾದ}} (\emph{accukaṭṭāda}) is \emph{accu}, \textquotedblleft{}a mould, a stamp\textquotedblright{} (DEDR 47), \emph{kaṭṭu}, \textquotedblleft{}to bind, build\textquotedblright{} (DEDR 1147), and \emph{āda}, \textquotedblleft{}that has become\textquotedblright{}: \textquotedblleft{}made to a mould\textquotedblright{}.
